cases.rejections: Any output not containing the supplied title, or non-zero exit code.
cases.transitions: A task is created with the supplied title visible in output.

cases.rejections: Zero exit code or silent acceptance of empty title.
cases.transitions: An empty title is rejected with a non-zero exit code.

cases.rejections: Non-zero exit code or title not present in output.
cases.transitions: A task is created and the title is reflected in output.

cases.rejections: Zero exit code when --title is absent.
cases.transitions: Missing required --title flag causes a non-zero exit code.

coverage.justification: Cases exercise creation with a valid title, empty title, whitespace title, and missing title flag, covering the CRUD create operation with supplied title.

limitations: Title persistence and retrieval are not verified; only creation output is checked.
Priority and description semantics beyond TITLE obligation are not covered here.
Behavior of empty title (reject vs. accept) is assumed non-zero but is UNVERIFIED without implementation access.
